row:
Aberystwyth University, on the west coast of Wales, is your place to study, explore and grow. Since 1872, we’ve built a global reputation for teaching excellence and ground-breaking research. Aberystwyth University has been placed top in Wales for student satisfaction for nine consecutive years (National Student Survey 2024), is ranked Welsh University of the year, and is in the top 3 universities in the UK for teaching quality and student experience (Good University Guide 2024, The Times and Sunday Times).  

Subscribe to our Official YouTube Channel to discover more about Aberystwyth University.  

The information in these videos is accurate at the time of publishing.
